rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when the harmful or incapacitating effect is described generally.

example.traditional: 嗰場火災造成嚴重損失。
example.jyutping: go2 coeng4 fo2 zoi1 zou6 sing4 jim4 zung6 syun2 sat1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that a person, organization, or system is put out of action.

example.english: The cyberattack had a crippling effect and left the hospital unable to function.
example.traditional: 嗰次黑客攻擊令間醫院癱瘓，連急症室都開唔到。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 haak1 haak3 gung1 gik1 ling6 gaan1 ji1 jyun2 taan1 wun6 lin4 gap1 zing3 sat1 dou1 hoi1 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this for a crippling burden such as debt, costs, or sustained pressure.

example.english: The crippling debt left the whole family unable to breathe easy.
example.traditional: 沉重嘅債務壓到成家人都透唔到氣。
example.jyutping: cam4 zung6 ge3 zaai3 mou6 aat3 dou3 sing4 gaa1 jan4 dou1 tau3 m4 dou3 hei3
